lines.text: Someone just taught Claude to turn PS2 games into PC games,
and it's not an emulator. It rebuilds the actual game as a real PC program.
It's called Console Skill. Eleven free Claude skills on GitHub for PS2 games you own.
Then you can mod it just by asking. Sharper graphics, new levels, your own controller.
Game crashes? The tester skill finds out why.
Then play it on Windows, Mac, Linux, even a Steam Deck.
It's still early, so not every game boots yet.
Comment "console" and I'll send you the link and the setup.
